narrative:
## Handover Summary — Operating Costs & CIR

Ten cost centres validated with headcount and non-headcount lines and driver-based items (valuations, broker events, FSCS and BoE levies, best-buy partner fees).

## Key Decisions
• IT change spend re-phased into Q4 (timing, not savings)
• FSCS and BoE levy accruals updated for the larger deposit base
• Marketing per £ of origination capped at 0.12%

## Recommendation for CapEx
Prioritise the broker portal digitisation — it removes manual case handling and supports the bridging growth case.

signals.title: Cost-income ratio improved to 48.8%
signals.excerpt: Administrative expenses £84.6M; FTEs 421 → 458; multi-year investment programme in digitisation and AI.
